_: Soul sand wears as sand (Xep, 2026-11-06: Let them wear). Named here because the rules refuse every block called soul and, from 1.16.5, every block short of its cell, and one block of the game's should not move that line for every mod's. Nether wart holds its square because it is planted there, as wheat is on farmland, and a path worn through a wart bed would otherwise break the crop.

From the plain census of 1.12.2 (W4 R4, judged 2026-11-09), as 1.7.10's from FTB Infinity's. In this game stone_stairs are cobblestone stairs, made from cobblestone and drawn with it, so they wear as cobble; the rules read the stone in the name. Hardened clay in every color, plain sandstone (value 0; chiseled and smooth are made) and obsidian are natural rock the rules leave out: hardened clay has no stone word, and sandstone and obsidian are on the decorative list so that their bricks and made blocks stay out. Clay is packed earth of river beds, on a material no rule reads. Magma is natural rock of the Nether's floor, and its name holds no nether word.
Named one by one because any word a rule could read would take other mods' blocks with it, and because a file reaches a config that already holds detection's line where a changed rule does not.

From RLCraft 2.9.3's census of 1.12.2 (W4 R5, judged 2026-11-12): plain red sandstone (value 0; chiseled and smooth are made) is natural rock of the deserts and mesas, stone as plain sandstone is. An entry of its own beside the plain census's, so their checks still read their own lines; its stairs were not judged and stay out.

A slab or stair takes its full block's ruling (Xep, 2026-11-13: Can we make it so all slabs of blocks that wear, also wear, in their own like the full blocks do? and: Same with stairs as slabs; W4 R15). These are this mod's slabs and stairs whose full blocks a census of 1.12.2 judged, each named at its full block's family so it wears on its own texture as the full block does, at the values that hold its full block's own material. A slab or stair of a block the census excluded, or never judged, is left as it was. Where an earlier note here leaves this mod's slabs and stairs to the rules, or to detection's family, the ones named below no longer are.
